title: No variable grind
text: No variable grind. I bought this because it is getting harder to use my hand pepper grinder due to my arthritis. It was easy to use and reasonably easy to fill though it does not hold a lot of pepper. In trying to wash the thing prior to use, it has MANY tiny parts....good luck! And, though it has an adjustment for the size of the particles, it only does very very fine grind....NOT what I like. So I am returning it.
